title: Future isolated Trivy disk guard experiment run (not executed)

status.description: Do not map missing proof to success

environment.description: VM identity, architecture, kernel, imageID, snapshotter, UID/GID, controller version/temp, filesystem device/type/features/block size/reserved ratio/mounts, overlay/temp/cache placement, virtual and physical capacity, egress policy result; only synthetic/lab identity.

implementation.description: frozen source paths+SHA256, Trivy --version/binary SHA, image digest, effective argv with credential references redacted, guard source unchanged.

artifacts.description: official manifest bytes SHA256, Docker-Content-Digest, layer digest/media/size, mirror source, pinned public old/new DB identities; no bearer token.

guard.description: capacityBytes, formulaVersion, nodefs/imagefs stat freshness, initial headroom band, owned lab Lease proof, guard rejection/acceptance before any download; no lowered threshold.

initial.description: df/statvfs/allocated du/apparent sizes, DB+metadata hashes, device/inodes, cache/temp/upperdir/backing baseline.

peak.description: per-device sampled high-water, reconstructed peak bytes, algorithm/version, event counts/loss/gaps/errorBound, measurement confidence; null truePeak if not proven. Unit bytes. Include simultaneous components and host backing peak separately.

directories.description: cache/db/java-db, /tmp/oci-download, nested temporary dirs, upper/work dirs/controller-temp growth; inode and st_blocks to dedupe.

final.description: DB logical/allocated sizes, metadata and schema/freshness, isolated offline readability result, residual temp and DB checksums.

cleanup.description: process/pid ownership stop, open deleted allocations, per-directory residue at exit/+1/+10/+60s, CLEAN/RESIDUE/PARTIAL/UNKNOWN; isolated destruction receipt after seal.

failure.description: phase, requested trigger, observed operation, errno/signal, exitStatus, diagnostic sanitized; null-trigger success separate.

productionImpact.description: production writes/refresh/scan/rollout/release=0; proof of isolated API and denied prod addresses. Any nonzero invalidates run.

integrity.description: relative paths/SHA256/bytes of every artifact, external manifest digest; no mutable self-certification as approval.

timeline.description: Full UTC+monotonic statvfs and event trace references with clock mapping and gaps

repeatGroup.description: Same initial seed + target digest + FS; no silently merging changed tag/digest cohorts
